description: This Java source file contains unit tests for the DefaultMuteableConnectionLogger class within the Eclipse Ditto project. It tests muting/unmuting functionality and verification that logging methods do not call the delegate when muted.

classes.name: DefaultMuteableConnectionLoggerTest
classes.description: Unit test class for verifying the behavior of DefaultMuteableConnectionLogger, especially muting functionality and interaction with delegate logger.

methods.name: mute
methods.description: Tests that the mute method sets the logger to a muted state.

methods.name: unmute
methods.description: Tests that the unmute method switches the logger to an unmuted state.

methods.name: testMutingAndUnmuting
methods.description: Verifies toggling mute and unmute works correctly, and logger's muted state updates as expected.

methods.name: mutedLoggerShouldNotCallDelegate
methods.description: Ensures that when the logger is muted, logging calls do not invoke delegate methods.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Verifies successful logging via delegate when logger is unmuted.

methods.name: success1
methods.description: Verifies success logging with message and ThingId.

methods.name: failure1
methods.description: Verifies failure logging with message and ThingId.

methods.name: exception
methods.description: Verifies exception logging with exception object.

methods.name: exception1
methods.description: Verifies exception logging with message and ThingId.

methods.name: getLogs
methods.description: Checks that getLogs method returns underlying delegate logs.

methods.name: testEqualsAndHashcode
methods.description: Verifies that the class's equals and hashCode methods work as intended.
